title: Russian Chicken Dumplings
description: A hearty Russian-inspired dish featuring chicken and dumplings in a savory sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the quenched dumplings according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the russian dill and cook for 1 minute.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the cooked dumplings.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
